setup: Delivered order; one mapped SKU; all six targets eligible
expected_result: Return six ranked unique recommendations.

setup: Two distinct mapped SKUs; equal allocation
expected_result: Equal allocation (3 initial slots per source), then priority-ordered backfill if needed.

setup: Three distinct mapped SKUs
expected_result: Equal allocation of 2 slots per source; M <= 6 deterministic source priority order (eligible_candidate_count desc, first_line_index asc, product_code asc).

setup: Four distinct mapped SKUs
expected_result: Equal allocation of 2,2,1,1 assigned in M <= 6 deterministic source priority order (eligible_candidate_count desc, first_line_index asc, product_code asc) without quantity influencing remainder slots.

scenario: More than six mapped ordered SKUs
setup: Seven distinct mapped SKUs (e.g., line 1 has fewer eligible candidates or lower quantity_sum than line 7)
expected_result: No arbitrary first-six truncation; evaluate eligibility across all mapped sources first, rank by M > 6 deterministic source priority (eligible_candidate_count desc, quantity_sum desc, first_line_index asc, product_code asc), assign 1 equal initial slot to top six prioritized sources, and include all mapped sources in round-robin backfill.

setup: Same SKU appears on multiple order lines
expected_result: Aggregate to one source SKU; do not give it multiple base quotas; quantity_sum is used only as a source-prioritization tie-breaker when M > 6 (never influences M <= 6 remainder allocation or slot weighting) and is retained in trace.

setup: A mapped target is also in current order
expected_result: Exclude purchased target regardless of source mapping rank.

setup: Two source mappings contain same target SKU
expected_result: Return target once; retain first deterministic provenance; backfill if needed.

setup: Candidate has available_quantity = 0
expected_result: Exclude and scan next ranked candidate.

setup: Candidate has is_active = false
expected_result: Exclude and scan next ranked candidate.

setup: Candidate has is_rx = true
expected_result: Always exclude; never recommend.

setup: Candidate metadata missing or Rx flag unknown
expected_result: Fail closed for candidate; record exclusion reason.

setup: One order SKU mapped, another not mapped
expected_result: Use mapped source(s); redistribute quota equally across mapped sources; do not fail whole order.

setup: No ordered SKU exists in mapping table
expected_result: Return empty result and do not send WhatsApp message.

setup: Only four unique eligible targets remain after filters
expected_result: Return four when eligible candidates are exhausted; do not relax filters, invent products, or invoke global bestseller fallback (future enhancement only).

setup: All candidates purchased/Rx/unavailable/inactive/unknown
expected_result: Return empty result; do not send recommendation message.

setup: Event says processing/shipped or authoritative order state not delivered
expected_result: Do not compute/send recommendations.

setup: Same order/campaign delivery event received twice
expected_result: Only one dispatch; second event is idempotent no-op.

setup: Customer messaging status blocks outbound message
expected_result: Compute may be retained for audit, but do not dispatch message.

scenario: WhatsApp provider failure, acceptance & simulator selection semantics
setup: Meta Cloud API transient error, acceptance vs webhook delivery status, and explicit simulator/missing-credential selection
expected_result: Do not auto-switch to simulator on real Meta API failure; retry Meta transient failure safely and record failed/pending state; record Meta API acceptance (PROVIDER_ACCEPTED) separately from Meta webhook delivery confirmation (DELIVERED); select simulator only in explicit simulator mode or when credentials are unavailable.

setup: Missing order_id, invalid status, blank SKU or invalid quantity
expected_result: Reject with validation error; no recommendation or dispatch.

setup: Missing header, incomplete rank pair, duplicate source key
expected_result: Fail dataset load with actionable validation errors.

setup: Same inputs submitted repeatedly
expected_result: Identical source priority order, product selection order, and preserved provenance (source_product_code, original mapping_rank) across repeated runs.

setup: Eligible candidates from one source have ranks 1–6
expected_result: Lower mapping rank considered before higher rank within each prioritized source.
